Dates
Sat, May 29 – Sun, May 30, 2027
Where
Durango (to Silverton), CO

McDonald's Citizen Tour 50 miles Durango to Silverton; Coca-Cola Road Race on the same 50-mile course; Quarter Horse 25 miles to Purgatory Resort (2,300+ ft); LaStrada LaPlata Gravel Race 55 miles; Subaru Mountain Bike Race
Elevation
Two passes above 10,000 ft (Coal Bank and Molas) on the 50-mile Durango-Silverton route

multi-discipline festival weekend: citizen road tour, road race, gravel and MTB races
Cause

Iron Horse Bicycle Classic (nonprofit)
Registration
REGISTRATION OPENS DECEMBER 4, 2026 for the 2027 edition

DateThe official Iron Horse Bicycle Classic site carries a 'SAVE THE DATE' for Saturday May 29 and Sunday May 30 with 'REGISTRATION OPENS DECEMBER 4, 2026' - that combination identifies the 2027 (54th) edition, since the 53rd edition ran May 22-24, 2026. May 29-30, 2027 is Memorial Day weekend (Memorial Day = Mon May 31, 2027).

NotesThe famous 'Race Against the Train' - riders race the Durango & Silverton Narrow Gauge Railroad steam train to Silverton. The citizen tour (untimed) is the mass-participation event; the road race is the competitive version. Friday brings registration and the kick-off parade; Sunday has gravel/MTB racing and a cycling festival.

Event siteSources: ironhorsebicycleclassic.com cyclingwest.com

I’d like to say I ride for everyone else. I ride because it changed me.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and every ride gets written down. The money goes through the orgs’ own rides. It never touches me.
